sentences.en: A grim national record has been set in Orlando, Florida, the deadliest mass shooting in U.S.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州奥兰多发生了一起惨绝人寰的全国性悲剧，这是美国历史上伤亡最惨重的大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: It's being investigated as an act of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 目前该事件正作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。

sentences.en: Every time there's a terrorist attack, we ask ourselves, what could motivate someone to commit mass murder?
sentences.zh: 每当发生恐怖袭击，我们都会自问：究竟是什么动机驱使一个人去进行大规模屠杀？

sentences.en: Although it's still early in the investigation, we know enough to say that this was an act of terror and an act of hate.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查尚处于早期阶段，但我们已掌握足够的信息，可以断定这是一起恐怖行为，也是一起仇恨行为。

sentences.en: Officials say 29-year-old Omar Mateen called 911 to pledge allegiance to the Islamic State during his rampage inside The Pulse, a gay nightclub in Orlando.
sentences.zh: 官方称，29岁的奥马尔·马丁在奥兰多一家名为“脉动”的同性恋夜店行凶期间，曾拨打911电话宣誓效忠“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: Was he motivated by religious fervor?
I remember asking similar questions after the shooting in San Bernardino last year.
sentences.zh: 我记得去年圣贝纳迪诺枪击案发生后，我也问过类似的问题。

sentences.en: Many people first thought that a disgruntled employee was behind that attack.
sentences.zh: 当时许多人首先想到的是，那次袭击背后是一名心怀不满的员工。

sentences.en: Later, we learned the killers had pledged allegiance to the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 后来我们得知，凶手曾宣誓效忠“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: The truth is, we may never fully understand.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们可能永远无法完全理解。

sentences.en: Some terrorists may be motivated solely by religious fervor.
sentences.zh: 有些恐怖分子可能纯粹是出于宗教狂热。

sentences.en: Others might be cloaking personal grievances in the garb of something grander.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人可能只是披着宏大叙事的外衣，来掩盖个人的不满。

sentences.en: In fact, capitalizing on the personal frustrations of potential recruits is an explicit strategy of the Islamic State,
sentences.zh: 事实上，利用潜在招募对象的个人挫败感，是“伊斯兰国”的一项明确策略，

sentences.en: according to anthropologist Scott Atron, who has studied the group.
sentences.zh: 研究该组织的社会人类学家斯科特·阿特兰如是说。

sentences.en: The strategy of the Islamic State is quite simple and very well spelled out.
sentences.zh: “伊斯兰国”的策略非常简单，而且阐述得非常清楚。

sentences.en: We will find out who in our enemy populations have grievances, have frustrated personal aspirations.
sentences.zh: 我们会找出敌对人群中哪些人有怨气，哪些人有受挫的个人抱负。

sentences.en: We will draw that out, and we will wed it to the story we have of how the world should change and why.
sentences.zh: 我们会将其挖掘出来，并将其与我们关于世界应该如何改变以及为何改变的故事结合起来。

sentences.en: This week, we're going to share an episode we ran some months ago about why young people turn to terrorism and mass murder.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将重播几个月前制作的一期节目，探讨年轻人为何会转向恐怖主义和大规模屠杀。

sentences.en: Not all the ideas in this episode speak directly to the Orlando shooting,
sentences.zh: 虽然本期节目中的观点并非全部直接针对奥兰多枪击案，

sentences.en: but they're instructive because they highlight the psychological processes that drive people to theatrical displays of brutality and violence.
sentences.zh: 但它们具有启发意义，因为它们揭示了驱使人们进行戏剧性残暴和暴力行为的心理过程。

sentences.en: We're going to use Atron's anthropological lens and studies on would-be suicide bombers by an Israeli psychologist
sentences.zh: 我们将利用阿特兰的人类学视角，以及一位以色列心理学家对准自杀式炸弹袭击者的研究，

sentences.en: to explore the attraction of terrorist outfits in faraway lands.
sentences.zh: 来探索遥远国度的恐怖组织为何具有吸引力。

sentences.en: But even for those who never travel far from home, there are striking psychological similarities between radicalization
sentences.zh: 但即使对于那些从未远行的人来说，激进化与一些专家所称的“自我激进化”之间，

sentences.en: and what some experts call self-radicalization.
sentences.zh: 也存在着惊人的心理相似性。

sentences.en: As we come to terms with the horror of what unfolded in Orlando,
sentences.zh: 当我们努力接受奥兰多所发生的恐怖事件时，

sentences.en: you may want to think of this episode as a primer on some of the counterintuitive conclusions social scientists are reaching
sentences.zh: 你可以把这期节目看作是一份入门指南，了解社会科学家在研究现代恐怖主义本质时，

sentences.en: as they study the nature of modern terrorism.
sentences.zh: 所得出的一些反直觉的结论。

sentences.en: I got a call from the medical school in Khartoum the other day where a professor at the medical school said
sentences.zh: 前几天我接到喀土穆医学院打来的电话，学院的一位教授说，

sentences.en: that her best students have just gone on to found a medical unit for the Islamic State,
sentences.zh: 她最优秀的学生刚刚去为“伊斯兰国”建立了一个医疗单位，

sentences.en: and this was completely unexpected, and what should she do about it?
sentences.zh: 这完全出乎意料，她该怎么办？

sentences.en: What should the school do about it?
He's an anthropologist who works at the University of Oxford, the University of Michigan,
sentences.zh: 他是一位人类学家，在牛津大学、密歇根大学，

sentences.en: and the French National Center for Scientific Research.
sentences.zh: 以及法国国家科学研究中心工作。

sentences.en: He has traveled to the front lines of war zones,
to cafes in Morocco, and housing projects in the Paris suburbs.
sentences.zh: 去过摩洛哥的咖啡馆，也去过巴黎郊区的保障性住房区。

sentences.en: He has spent many years trying to understand why people are drawn to join groups such as ISIS,
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直致力于研究人们为何会被吸引加入像ISIS这样的组织，

sentences.en: which is also known as the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 也就是众所周知的“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: So I get a call saying,
will you talk to us, our students?
sentences.zh: 你愿意和我们谈谈吗，和我们的学生谈谈？
我们不明白这是为什么。

sentences.en: They were our best students, our brightest students.
sentences.zh: 他们曾是我们最优秀、最聪明的学生。

sentences.en: And they went off to establish a medical clinic, we found out, with the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 结果我们发现，他们竟然去为“伊斯兰国”建立医疗诊所了。
他们的父母都快崩溃了。

sentences.en: We don't know what to tell them.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道该怎么告诉他们。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what's going on?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: The students were of Sudanese ancestry, and most had British passports.
sentences.zh: 这些学生是苏丹裔，大多数持有英国护照。

sentences.en: They had promising careers ahead of them.
Families of the medical students were dumbstruck.
sentences.zh: 医学生的家人们都惊呆了。

sentences.en: The heartbroken sister of one student spoke to the Daily Mail in Britain.
sentences.zh: 其中一名学生心碎的姐姐接受了英国《每日邮报》的采访。

sentences.en: And we just want her home.
Her family love her more than anybody else in this world can.
sentences.zh: 她的家人爱她胜过这世上任何人。

sentences.en: Nobody in this world can love her more than we do.
sentences.zh: 这世上没有人能比我们更爱她。

sentences.en: My little sister, she's an A-star student.
sentences.zh: 我的小妹妹，她是全优生。

sentences.en: They're preying on young, innocent girls, and it's just, it's not right.
sentences.zh: 他们正在猎捕年轻、无辜的女孩，这简直……这太不对了。

sentences.en: Atron said he told the teachers at the medical school
sentences.zh: 阿特兰说他告诉医学院的老师们，

sentences.en: the same thing he has been preaching for years to governments,
sentences.zh: 这和他多年来向各国政府宣讲的内容如出一辙，

sentences.en: and more recently, at the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 最近在联合国也是这么说的。

sentences.en: I said, listen, I can't give you the solution.
sentences.zh: 我说，听着，我无法给你们提供解决方案。

sentences.en: The solution has to be for you to pay attention,
sentences.zh: 解决方案在于你们要给予关注，

sentences.en: to listen to what they're telling you.
sentences.zh: 去倾听他们告诉你们的内容。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, if you had listened to them and engaged with them,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很明显，如果你们当初倾听他们并与他们接触，

sentences.en: you would have had indications of what was happening,
sentences.zh: 你们就会发现正在发生什么的迹象，

sentences.en: and you would have been able to talk to them.
sentences.zh: 并且你们本可以与他们沟通。

sentences.en: But like parents, the older authorities again know nothing
sentences.zh: 但就像父母一样，老一辈的权威人士又是一无所知，

sentences.en: and again are preaching nonsense things like moderation
sentences.zh: 又在宣扬一些毫无意义的东西，比如温和派，

sentences.en: or this isn't true Islam or whatever baloney they're giving them today.
sentences.zh: 或者说这不是真正的伊斯兰教，或者他们今天给出的任何胡言乱语。

sentences.en: And, of course, it means nothing.
Atron believes these messages won't be effective
sentences.zh: 阿特兰认为这些信息不会奏效，
因为它们从根本上误解了，

sentences.en: why the young medical students were drawn to the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 为什么年轻的医学生会被“伊斯兰国”所吸引。

sentences.en: The authorities painted the recruits as drawn to nihilism.
sentences.zh: 当局将这些招募对象描绘成被虚无主义所吸引。

sentences.en: Atron thinks it has more to do with a twisted idealism.
sentences.zh: 阿特兰认为这更多是与一种扭曲的理想主义有关。

sentences.en: The Islamic State revolution is a revolution.
There really isn't much difference I see in the impulse
sentences.zh: 在我看来，其冲动与动力，

sentences.en: or the impetus to the Islamic State revolution
sentences.zh: 与“伊斯兰国”革命的冲动与动力，

sentences.en: than to the French revolution or to the Bolshevik revolution
sentences.zh: 和法国大革命、布尔什维克革命，

sentences.en: or to the National Socialist revolution.
sentences.zh: 或是国家社会主义革命相比，并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: And it appeals to the same sorts of people.
sentences.zh: 而且它吸引的是同一类人。

sentences.en: or the Bolshevik revolution doesn't mean it will succeed.

sentences.en: But if Atron is right, it does mean that it would be a big mistake
sentences.zh: 但如果阿特兰是对的，这意味着低估“伊斯兰国”的吸引力，

sentences.zh: 在一段ISIS视频中，一名年轻的英国男子注视着镜头。
